name: Mandala Oracle
license: TO CONFIRM with the artist before this leaves the test branch. Files supplied by the artist for Stellar Tarot; terms of use not yet recorded.
notes: Source card 37 is the deck's intro card (how to use it, @thebarleymoon) and is not a playable card, so it is left out. The box front is not a card. Cards 2 and 32 carry the same affirmation in the supplied files; both are kept until the artist says otherwise. Card 4 wording (fears) to verify against the print. Card 1 has no coloured border in the supplied file. Card text read by OCR and spot-checked.

cards.text: I let go of the things that no longer serve me.
I am inhaling peace and exhaling stress.
I am doing my best, and that is enough.
I accept my fears and doubts, and try anyway.
My body tells me what it needs, and I am willing to listen.
I allow myself to heal.
I deserve all the good that comes to me.
I allow my feelings to flow.
My needs matter.
I am stronger than I know.
I am exactly where I'm meant to be.
I am at home in my body.
Everything is unfolding for my highest good.
I am thankful and grateful for the good in my life.
I allow the space and time for the right answer to arise.
Calmness washes over me with every deep breath I take.
I treat myself and my body with the love and respect I would show a dear friend.
I deserve a peaceful and loving life.
I have everything I will ever need within.
I am reclaiming my power.
I am capable of overcoming difficult challenges.
I trust my intuition.
Peace and happiness are inside of me.
I love the person that I am and the person I am becoming.
My outside world is a reflection of my inside world.
I set boundaries and respect them.
I follow my own heart, not the expectations of others.
Today, and every day, I choose joy.
My life is a blessing.
I trust the universe has my back.
I believe in my ability to get through tough times.
I am inhaling peace and exhaling stress.
My worth is not tied to how much I get done. I allow for rest and fun in my life.
Everything is going to be okay.
I deserve all the love and happiness there is.
I allow myself to rest, relax and reset without guilt.
